# Leaf Count Data 

Preliminary data counts as of 05/14/2026
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
leaf_count <- read.csv("Stipa_salinity_experiment_data - survival_leaves_2026_05_06.csv") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  select(
    water, 
    live_leaves,
    green_leaves, 
    salinity) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(live_leaves, green_leaves), 
    names_to = "leaf_type", 
    values_to = "count"
  ) |> 
  # 2. Convert salinity to a factor so it's treated as categories on the X-axis
  mutate(salinity = as.factor(salinity)) |> 
  # 3. Remove rows with missing values (NAs) to keep the graph clean
  drop_na(count) 

ggplot(leaf_count,
       mapping = aes(x = salinity,
                     y = count,
                     fill = leaf_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~water) +
  labs(
    title = "Leaf Counts by Salinity and Water Treatment",
    x = "Salinity Treatment (dS/m)",
    y = "Number of Leaves",
    fill = "Leaf Condition"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  # Custom colors for the leaves
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("green_leaves" = "forestgreen", "live_leaves" = "darkkhaki"),
    labels = c("Green Leaves", "Total Live Leaves")
  )
```

# Fluorescence data
Preliminary data counts as of 05/14/2026

```{r}
#| echo: false
metadata <- read.csv("Stipa_salinity_experiment_data - survival_leaves_2026_05_06.csv") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  select(new_id, salinity, water) # We only need these columns to "label" the fluorescence data

# 2. Load the fluorescence data
fluor_data <- read.csv("Stipa_salinity_experiment_data - fluorescence_2026_05_06.csv") |> 
  clean_names()

# 3. Join the datasets and clean up
# We use inner_join to match the Fm_values to their respective salinity/water treatment via 'new_id'
combined_fluor <- fluor_data |> 
  inner_join(metadata, by = "new_id") |> 
  drop_na(fm_value) |> 
  mutate(salinity = as.factor(salinity)) 

ggplot(combined_fluor, aes(x = salinity, y = fm_value, fill = water)) +
  # Using a boxplot to show the distribution of fluorescence across treatments
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  # Adding jittered points to show individual measurements (some plants have multiple)
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1), 
              alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~water) +
  labs(
    title = "Chlorophyll Fluorescence (Fm) by Salinity and Water Treatment",
    x = "Salinity Treatment (dS/m)",
    y = "Fm Value",
    fill = "Water Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("wet" = "steelblue", "dry" = "sienna3")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") # Hidden because facet labels already show Wet/Dry






```
